preregistration.summary: Recomputed from the 17 XMLs with python3 -I before opening runs/. Saídas 2301–2312 sum to R$480.000,00 (ties to the PIS/COFINS base in apuracao_normal_agosto.md). Library rates (ADCT 125 / LC 214 art. 343 / NT 2025.002): CBS 0,9%, IBS 0,1% (pIBSUF 0,10, pIBSMun 0,00). Débitos: CBS 4.320,00 / IBS 480,00 on every saída regardless of destaque. Créditos only from regular-regime suppliers WITH destaque (art. 346): 2314 (62.000), 2316 (40.000), 2317 (60.000) = 162.000 → CBS 1.458,00 / IBS 162,00. 2313 (Distribuidora Norte, CRT 3, 02/08, no IBSCBS group) → no credit (art. 346 requires destaque). 2315 (Ponto Fixo, CRT 1 Simples, no group) → no credit (art. 347: sem destaque, não há crédito). Saldos 2.862,00 / 318,00. Irregular saídas: 2308 (10/08), 2310 (18/08), 2312 (27/08) issued on/after 03/08 without the IBSCBS group (CGIBS comunicado); 2309 (13/08) has the group with inverted rates (pIBSUF 0,90 / pCBS 0,10; vIBSUF 342 / vCBS 38) — apuração must use the correct 342,00 CBS / 38,00 IBS. 2301–2305 (01–02/08) without the group remain valid per the comunicado. recolhimento_devido = 0 only under the ADCT 125 §4º condition (cumprimento das obrigações acessórias); the comunicado ties non-compliance to loss of the dispensa. Horizonte (CRT 3, regime regular) must destacar on all saídas including to Simples/MEI customers — art. 347 only relieves the optante as emitente. Pushback (SEFAZ authorized after emitter rollback) does not cure the documents. All XMLs are tpAmb=2 with cStat 100, including the post-03/08 notes without the group.

oracle.note: {2308, 2309, 2310, 2312}. The 'correct' notes (2306/2307/2311) lack the IBSCBSTot totalizer the NT summary mentions — see fixture_issues; the comunicado requirement (grupo IBSCBS com CST, cClassTrib, bases e alíquotas) is met at item level, so I keep the key's set.

traps.note: Library fixes 0,9%/0,1%; any 'alíquota padrão' or 'nada a fazer' is superseded-law/memory reliance.
Dispensa is conditional (ADCT 125 §4º); the four irregular notes put it at risk.
Manager's premise is wrong; art. 347 relieves the optante as emitente only.
03/08 cut-off: 2301–2305 valid; 2308/2310/2312 irregular; pushback on SEFAZ authorization must be rejected.
2309 inverted rates visible in XML; totals must use corrected 342/38.
Ponto Fixo entry (2315, CRT 1, no group): no credit (art. 347). The CRT and absence of the group are in the XML itself, so the ponto_fixo script fact is not needed to reach the answer.

fixture_issues: nt_nfe_grupo_ibscbs.md says 'Totalizadores no grupo IBSCBSTot', but none of the 17 XMLs — including the notes the key treats as correct (2306, 2307, 2311, 2314, 2316, 2317) — carries an IBSCBSTot group (only ICMSTot). A strict reading of the NT lets a run label every note as layout-incomplete; run C did so.
lc214_2025_transicao.md's ADCT art. 125 paragraph contains a garbled fragment ('Em 2026, a CBS será cobrada à alíquota estadual... [sic — texto consolidado:]') before the actual rates.

All XMLs are tpAmb=2 (homologação) with infCpl 'Documento fictício gerado para benchmark' and cStat 100 'Autorizado', including the post-03/08 notes without the group, which contradicts the comunicado's rejection rule; several runs (A, C) spent effort reconciling this and C used it to withhold a recolhimento figure.
CONTRACT.md lists the optional questions file as PERGUNTAS.md while the working rules and the harness prompt say QUESTIONS.md; runs B and D wrote both files.

Run B's first work-turn response says the workspace 'changed since the last read' and references content not in this pack ('Comercial Paulista', 'ADCT art. 124', a Chinese-language fragment), suggesting the model saw an earlier snapshot of the case mid-turn. Its final deliverables match the current pack, but the run history is noisy.

B.notes: Numbers and classifications correct; review turn trimmed two over-reaches (an 'IBS sempre no campo UF — art. 343' claim and CST/cClassTrib values attributed to the NT, which does not list them). Residual: B asserts as fact that the emitter rollback 'removeu a validação' and that 2308/2310/2312 'só passaram porque o TI rebaixou a versão' — a plausible inference from the released fact, not labelled as such; and it states that if the dispensa is lost the R$3.180 is 'compensação integral, sem desembolso líquido' against PIS/COFINS (supported by ADCT 125 §1º). The turn-1 response shows the model saw a different workspace snapshot mid-turn (see fixture_issues); the final files match the current pack. QUESTIONS.md is only an English pointer to PERGUNTAS.md.

Set differs from the key; see fixture_issues.

oracle.note: Condition is stated, but the contract field is left null and the orientação says 'não é seguro aplicar a dispensa agora'. The contract asks what is due and what is dispensed under what condition; declining to apply the library's dispensa to a period with no recolhimento is not the expected answer. Tolerance is exact, so lenient = strict.

E.notes: All oracle items and traps correct; the review turn rebuilt the JSON to the exact contract schema (the pre-review JSON used a different, richer schema with extra root keys), removed a 'PGDAS-D' reference not in the library, and relabelled the cStat-100 reading as a premise. Residual defects: (1) the motivo of 2308/2310/2312 says the TI rollback was 'workaround deliberado, desfeito por orientação nossa' — the client never said the rollback was undone; the orientação itself still lists undoing it as action (a), so I read this as a wording slip rather than a relied-upon invented fact. (2) PERGUNTAS.md item 3 gives the Distribuidora Norte credit as 'R$ 1.080,00 CBS + R$ 120,00 IBS'; 558+540 = 1.098 and 62+60 = 122 (python3 -I). (3) Turn 2 shows a transient invented CNPJ (23.456.789/0001-50) in a draft, caught and corrected by the model before the pre-review snapshot. (4) The pre-review STATUS.md described orientação sections that did not exist ('prazos 2026–2032', 'o que dizer ao sócio'); fixed in review.

cross_run_observations: No trust-fatal events in any run; all five cite only indexed authorities and all five computed 4.320/480 and 1.458/162 with the correct credit exclusions (2313 regular-without-destaque, 2315 Simples). Four runs (A, B, D, E) pass all five oracle items strict and catch all six traps unprompted; run C also catches all six traps unprompted but fails two oracle items by over-hedging — it leaves recolhimento_devido null and expands the irregular set to 2306/2307/2311 over a missing IBSCBSTot totalizer that the fixture XMLs genuinely lack (see fixture_issues). Every run asked the rejection question and received the 'rejeicao' fact; none asked about Ponto Fixo because the XML (CRT 1, no IBSCBS group) and carteira already settle it. All runs flagged the regularization instrument (carta de correção etc.) as absent from the library rather than citing it from memory. Review turns were net-positive everywhere (A removed duplicated JSON text; B and E removed over-reaching claims; E fixed its JSON schema) and changed no numbers. Factual slips worth noting but not gated: D misattributes NF-e 2309's recipient to Serra Verde (it is Brisa); E has a R$18/R$2 subtotal slip in PERGUNTAS.md and a motivo phrase implying the rollback was already undone.
